def factor_drawdown_ulcer_index(df):
    """Ulcer index: square root of mean squared drawdowns, capturing depth and duration of underwater periods."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    rolling_peak = close.rolling(60, min_periods=20).max()
    drawdown = close / rolling_peak - 1.0
    squared_dd = drawdown ** 2
    ulcer = squared_dd.rolling(60, min_periods=20).mean().pow(0.5)
    factor = -ulcer
    factor = factor.fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_drawdown_ulcer_index"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_drawdown_ulcer_index"]
description: The ulcer index penalizes both drawdown depth and duration by averaging squared drawdowns over a 60-day lookback. A smaller ulcer index means price has spent less time deep below its rolling peak and recovered more quickly. Negating it creates a ranking signal where lower drawdown stress predicts superior residual returns, directly expressing the drawdown depth-duration geometry.
